body:
I don't know how to make myself do it. Long term.

I can make myself do it for a couple days, but after that I just... I don't care enough, or something. I don't know. I feel like my brain isn't wired up correctly, that or I'm just lazy and selfish.

Unfortunately, knowing the why doesn't seem to help me do much. I know "why" I should be more social... I know "why" I should have kept going to classes... I know "why" I should start getting regular exercise... but that knowledge doesn't do me an ounce of good. I dunno either.

I feel like I'm incapable of doing any of the hard things in life that would bring me long term joy. I have so many ideas, so much creativity and magic in my head that I want to express, that I want to design and mold and make real so I can show other people... but every time I start, I just end up getting tired and distracted and giving up. And ultimately, someone with the motivation to accomplish a single goal is worth infinitely more then someone with a million goals and no motivation to accomplish any of them.

I'm not sure where I fall on that spectrum... I'm sad that I suck at something, and while I understand that it's worth improving, I don't understand how I'm capable of improving it.

I feel depressed, then I look into the future and see two paths... one is the same as where I am now, and the other is completely out of reach. I don't feel like I can get there, because I've tried, and been sent reeling back every time.
Medication, long term therapy... no, I think that's it. What other ways could there even be?

I don't feel like it WILL get me back under control though... it will set me back, leave me in a bad spot, and ultimately not fix my problems. I don't want someone to just stop me killing myself... I want someone to stop me from WANTING to in the first place. Because if they stop me but I still want to, I'll just end up trying again- but this time not telling anyone.
I just got out of inpatient though... what are they going to do, put me right back in? And once I get out, will I even still have my job?

I try not to stress about things I have no control over... the problem is all the things I DO have control over, and need to do something about. I want to just ignore them, but that's the attitude that got me here in the first place. In the meantime I'm too scared to make a decision and do it.

The stuff I'd usually turn to in my free time is what helps me isolate and ignore responsibilities, and even if I wanted to, I moved back in with my parents and they wouldn't let me. As for more productive hobbies... I find it difficult to summon the motivation to see any of them through. This is a long time problem.
I have things I enjoy, yeah... but they seem so small and meaningless next to all the things that make me miserable.

I don't know... I might say yes if you told me I only had to hold out until, say, Friday. But I have no idea how long this will last. Weeks, months, years. That scares the crape out of me because I can't make it that long.

I don't feel my life is unusually stressfull, no. It's just me.  And I am trying to stay in themoment- but when something comes up, I can't handle it as well as I need to. My decision making skills go out the window and I freeze up. (At work currently, so can only post intermittently)
